أكفهر (form IVq)
# أَكْفَهِرُّ (ʔakfahirru) /ʔak.fa.hir.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْفَهَرَّ (ikfaharra)
# أَكْفَهِرَّ (ʔakfahirra) /ʔak.fa.hir.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْفَهَرَّ (ikfaharra)
# أَكْفَهِرِّ (ʔakfahirri) /ʔak.fa.hir.ri/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِكْفَهَرَّ (ikfaharra)
